Question 4
?

A=[1−4−3258119],B=[0−5−1203−10119]

By applying elementary row operations of the form Ri:=Ri+kR3, the matrix A can be transformed into the matrix B. What are the elementary row operations?

a
R1:=R1−R3 and R2:=R2−2R3
b
R1:=R1+R3 and R2:=R2+2R3
c
R1:=R1−R3 and R2:=R2+2R3
d
R1:=R1−R3 and R2:=R2−R3
e
R1:=R1+R3 and R2:=R2−2R3
Submit
